meta.scenario_label: Harmonic filter detuning: 18.5 Hz interharmonic grows on the 4.16 kV bus (ELEC) -> agitator torsional mode (AREA_A.RX.AGD)
meta.day_axis: day[k] = k + 0.5 (hour 12 of day k); one sample per day, downsampled from hourly
meta.smoothing: Francis, causal: value = trailing moving average of the last 49 hourly samples; order n = backward difference of order n-1, re-smoothed by a trailing 9-sample average; units per day^n; no future sample is used

quantities.sigma: entropy generation inside the node: its assets (port designed losses + bonds) + couplings with both ends inside, DC + AC lines, kW/K (each loss weighted by T_amb / T at its design temperature; T_amb = 298.15 K; exergy destruction = T_amb x sigma)
quantities.boundary_power: net power INTO the node through its boundary couplings (power at the node-side port; thermal = heat flow) plus plant boundary ports inside it, DC + time-averaged AC, MW
quantities.fault_band_power: the boundary_power part in the headline fault band only (time-averaged AC), trailing 49-sample average, MW; order 0 only
quantities.damage: max Miner damage fraction over the node's assets (1 = failure), order 0 only; null = zero for the whole run
